label: Kitchen remodel
job: We want to redo our small galley kitchen for $25,000 or less. We are keeping the layout, but want new cabinets, counters, a backsplash and appliances. Where should the money go, what order do we do things in, and what usually goes wrong?

label: Salary negotiation
job: I have a job offer for $96,000 as a senior operations analyst. I want $110,000. The offer expires in three days. How do I ask for more without losing the offer, and what do I say on the call?

label: Team tool switch
job: Our team of six runs everything through email and a shared spreadsheet. We want to move to a shared task tool in two weeks without dropping any client work. Give us a plan for choosing the tool, moving the work over, and getting everyone to actually use it.
